title: Bausch Health notifies customers that personal information was acquired in a June 2026 intrusion
date_note: The day the notice was reported to the California Attorney General (the register's Reported Date, 11/20/2026); the sample letter filed there is dated November 25, 2026. The letter says the period of unauthorized access was June 24 to July 1, 2026.
geo_basis: address on the notice letterhead (400 Somerset Corporate Boulevard, Bridgewater, NJ)
summary: Bausch Health filed a breach notice with California's Attorney General. Its letter says that on July 1, 2026 it identified unauthorized access to a limited number of company records, with access from June 24 to July 1, 2026, and on October 28, 2026 found that recipients' names and contact information, plus other data varying by person, were acquired. It says it is cooperating with law enforcement; the Rhode Island section lists 119 residents notified.
plain: Bausch Health says someone got into some company records between June 24 and July 1, 2026 and took customers' names, contact details and other personal data.
exec: Customer personal data was acquired from Bausch Health's records; recipients should watch for fraud.
action: Bausch Health's letter urges recipients to review financial statements and credit reports for suspicious activity and offers credit monitoring through Cyberscout, with enrollment within 90 days of the letter.
impact: The Rhode Island section of the letter lists 119 Rhode Island residents notified; no total is stated.

sources.name: California Attorney General: Bausch Health Companies Inc. breach notification

report.publisher: Bausch Health Companies Inc. (filed with the California Attorney General)
key_findings: On July 1, 2026, Bausch Health identified evidence of unauthorized access to a limited number of company records.
Its investigation identified June 24 to July 1, 2026 as the period of unauthorized access.
On October 28, 2026 it identified that names and contact information, with other data that varies by recipient, were acquired.
Bausch Health says it is cooperating fully with law enforcement.
recommendations: Review financial account statements and credit reports for suspicious activity; enroll in the offered credit monitoring within 90 days.

evidence.quote: Our investigation identified June 24, 2026-July 1, 2026, as the period of unauthorized access.
There were 119 Rhode Island residents notified in this incident
To receive the monitoring services described above, you must enroll within 90 days from the date of this letter.

validation.note: Primary: Bausch Health's own notice letter, filed with and published by the California Attorney General (register entry sb24-633182, breach date 06/24/2026, reported 11/20/2026). No other publisher read.

review.note: Compared title, dates (Jul 1 identified, Jun 24-Jul 1 access, Oct 28 finding), 119 RI residents, law enforcement, Cyberscout 90-day enrolment against the filed letter; letter dated Nov 25 as date_note says
